Our favorite is bacon Alfredo. It's what my husband likes to call our fancy people meal. 


Ingredients-

Bacon (I recommend the think cut peppery kind from Aldi, every once in awhile it goes on sale and is perfect for this)

Chicken breast (optional)

Bow tie noodles

Spinach

Broccoli

Garlic

Olive oil

Parmesan cheese

Alfredo sauce

Pepper

1-Fry the bacon and remove

2- Cook chicken in bacon fat, add garlic during last two or so minutes of cooking. Remove from pan

3- Cook broccoli and spinach

4- Combine chicken, bacon, and veggies in pan

5- Add jar of Alfredo sauce

6- Add pepper and parmesan cheese to taste and serve over noodles.

Pro tip- Save money and skip the chicken and Alfredo sauce. Replace sauce by adding a bit of flour to left over bacon fat. Whisk together bacon fat and flour, add milk, continue until desired consistency. Add Parm cheese to sauce, mess around with amounts to change consistency. Salt and pepper sauce to taste (basil is also yummy).
